race.comment: TISANI JAMES (10) has been racing in tougher company lately, and will have the blinkers on for the first time, which will help keep his mind on the job. A wide draw is against him, but with more upside than most in this field, we have him on top. PAINTED WINGS (12) was recently bought out of Victoria, and ran his best race yet when finishing third here 2 weeks ago over an unsuitable 1210m. The extra 415m here is the key, and she can pick up a win in this area at short notice. GUNNA WANNABE (9) ran on late for fifth fresh up at Moree just over 2 weeks ago and probably should have won that day. If the gaps come at the right time, then he can have the last say here. I'M ON FIRE (5) has recently joined the local William Kropp stable, and he was a fast finishing third here 2 weeks ago over a similar trip. He cops another wide draw, but is good enough to win a race like this, so stick with him. LITTLE MISS CLASSY (11) steps up in trip for the first time this prep, and is worth including.
